test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The sight of food maddened him.

options.text: He has maddened by the sight of food.
He was maddened by the sight of food.
He is maddened by the sight of food.
He had maddened by the sight of food.

solution:
The correct answer is** ****He was maddened by the sight of food.**
